notes.title: Superfly v1.3.1 Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone, it’s the day you never thought would come again… We’re releasing another update! This update includes building destruction, and… [i][b]our very first cosmetics![/b][/i] Two features we know you guys have been asking about for years. 

Now for a little bit more about this surprise holiday update. Starting with building destruction! As it so happens, Dr. Suffers years of mindless chaos has caused just a little bit of issues with upkeeping the city. So, you’ll notice as you fly that there are now some new construction zones to interact with. These will look like plain concrete buildings with construction gear around the outside. At these zones, not only can you destroy the buildings to your hearts content, you can also go inside them! Granted, they’re under construction, so there’s not much inside. But, we can’t wait to see you fulfill your superhero dreams by finally slamming the robots through the buildings! One last note on building destruction, [b]not all buildings are destructible,[/b] only the ones in [i][b]construction zones.[/b][/i] Sorry to disappoint guys, full city destruction would’ve exploded your headsets.  

On to our next exciting new feature – cosmetics! Each power has 2 different new color sets you can choose from. This gives you a total of 24 new glove color combinations inspired by 24 different superheroes and supervillains! Not only that, but you can change the colors of your powers to match your new gloves. Or mix and match colors to make your own unique superhero (or villain). 

And finally, we’ve also re-enabled snow by default for the entire city. Explore all the new features in a lovely winter wonderland all through the festive season! We hope you have a great time with this special new holiday update. 

As always, don’t forget to check out our [url=https://discord.gg/667M4en7k2]Discord[/url] if you find any bugs, or have other questions, comments, or suggestions about Superfly! And a big thanks to the players on Discord who helped us test out this update.

Happy Holidays!

[/list]

notes.title: Superfly v1.2.3 Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone! We’re back with another update for y’all. This minor update adds clearer story mode progression, more sounds for some of our newer enemies, updates the tutorial voice lines, and fixes several bugs. 

Now, when you start up the game for the first time, you will be presented with a difficulty selection screen. As always, you can change your difficulty any time from Settings > Gameplay as well, but we wanted to make it more user friendly for first time players. Along that same line, we added a gear collection progress bar for story mode so you can see your progress in real time. You’ll also be able to [i]hear[/i] your progress in real time, as new voice lines from Dr. Suffer play every time you unlock a new power. And keep your ears open, some of Dr. Suffers lines have been updated to include [i]real[/i] meows from our team’s actual IRL cats!

Besides adding more Dr. Suffer, we also took some time to make his creations sound a little more fearsome. Look out for new sounds and voice lines for the Juggerbot and Steelbreath The Annihilator! Don’t know who Juggerbot and Steelbreath The Annihilator are? Those are the new [b][i]community selected[/i][/b] names that came from our [url=https://youtu.be/SnVqNczDhas]Enemy Naming Competition[/url]! We want to give a big thank you again to the users in our discord who participated in the competition. We love the new names you guys have picked, and hope you’re all excited to see them reflected in the achievements this update!
 
Now on to a slightly less fun part of the update: bug fixes! We fixed several bugs in this update to make your Superfly experience better. No longer shall you get the all red world of doom upon loading in, or destroy a thousand boats wondering why you can’t get the achievement, as well as many more fixes you can see in the changelog. 

We also wanted to let you know we have noticed many users reporting a very specific bug: [b]Being able to move your hands,[/b] [i][b]but not being able to click anything.[/b][/i] Thanks to our community members helping us out debugging, this should now be fixed. [i][b]If you still experience this bug after updating to 1.2.3, please email us at contact@locomotiondevs.com or join our [url=https://discord.gg/667M4en7k2]Discord[/url] so we can get debugging files from you. If you’re not able to assist us debugging, no worries! We’ve also added a temporary solution to this bug to our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1413020/discussions/]FAQ[/url] just in case you still experience issues after updating to 1.2.3. [/b][/i]

And that’s Minor Update 1.2.3! We hope you enjoy playing Superfly, and as always, join our [url=https://discord.gg/667M4en7k2]Discord[/url] for the most up to date game news, give suggestions, or get tech support if something isn’t working right!

notes.title: Superfly v1.2.2 Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone! It’s the moment you’ve all been secretly waiting for…[i] the new Wanted System update is live now![/i] Prepare to have a new life breathed into the city of Superfly. With more difficulty progression than ever before, a brand-new health system, 11 (yes, ELEVEN!) new and unique enemies, and updated building graphics, there’s something for all of you! Don’t worry, some of your familiar favorite enemies are still there too… but a couple of them might look a little different. (don’t tell them that, they get a little self-conscious.)

Now on to the fun stuff! The major change in this update is the brand new Wanted System, which also allowed us to introduce 11 new enemies to our roster, each with unique different abilities. You might remember Dr. Suffer is looking to find you after you escaped from his lab. Well, now your destruction comes with consequences! As you fly around the city “saving” those police cars by yeeting them off into the ocean, Dr. Suffer will notice you’re causing mayhem and send his goons after you! 

Similar to GTAV, you will now gain a Wanted Level the more you destroy property and robots. You can see this with our handy (ha) new Robot Head indicator located just under your left hand. Each Robot Head represents a further increase in difficulty, with the most difficult being 5 Robot Heads. Trust me, it’s a doozy to survive! You might even notice some interesting new effects if you make it to Wanted Level 5… (but you didn’t hear that from me)

Since this update majorly increases the difficulty of Superfly, we also want to take a brief moment to remind you of some existing difficulty settings located in Settings > Gameplay. You can lower your difficulty at any time (even make yourself invincible!), as well as lower the spawn rate of enemies, all without respawning. Or raise it! We encourage you to use these settings to tailor Superfly to [i]your personal level of difficulty[/i], as we know all players have a different idea of what is easy or hard to them. 

Next, we added a completely new health system. We’ve tried a few different versions of this in the past, from a red encroaching circle that made players nauseous, to our most recent system where you just sort of.. die, without warning. Unfortunately, the feedback we’ve gotten has been that those iterations haven’t quite hit the mark yet. 

For our new updated health system, we’ve finally added a health bar. It’ll appear on the back of your left wrist in game. As you take damage and lose health, it’ll go from green, to yellow, and eventually red before you die. You’ll also see some flashing red around your screen indicate that you’re taking damage, as well as a warning sound when you’re low on health, in case you don’t have a chance to look down. And don’t worry, if you die, you’ll just respawn back in the city center. 

As part of this health system update, we’ve also adjusted how you take damage. Not only do enemy attacks hurt you, but you can also enable the ability take fall damage now! You can find this setting under Settings > Gameplay, turn it on if you want even more of a challenge! We also adjusted how EMPs affect you, now each EMP will only disable one of your hands instead of both.

Now, on to the enemies. We added 11 new enemies to this update, to make for a total of 13 in our roster! I wanted to take a second to mention that our old Spider Bots and the Red Mech are gone…(RIP) While Dr. Suffer felt they performed valiantly, they both need some massive upgrades to be on par with all our new enemies. If you’ve seen our Enemy Naming Competition on [url=https://discord.gg/667M4en7k2]Discord[/url], you’ve already seen their 2.0 replacements! Please give a big warm welcome to the crawler 2.0* (not official name) and one-eyed mech 2.0* (not official name)! I know they just can’t wait to beat you! Er. I mean, meet you. Yeah, that’s what I meant.
 
There are also 9 other new enemies that you’ve never seen before, completely new to this update! Everything from a slimy tentacle bot all the way to a giant mechanical dragon, we have it all! While I’m tempted to tell you everything about all 9 new enemies, this announcement would be far too long if I did. You’ll just have to play the new update to find out, or head over to our Enemy Naming Competition on [url=https://discord.gg/667M4en7k2]Discord[/url] if you want to learn more about them before they obliterate you into pieces.

And lastly, we added new rainbow building colors to the entire city! We also updated the textures for the bottom section of all the buildings in the city to add brand new storefronts. Along with that, we adjusted the interior textures too. We hope you enjoy this added variety in your high rise fly by!

With all of that, I’d be remiss if I didn’t mention our future plans… Unfortunately, this is likely to be our last major content release. I know, I know, we’ve said that a dozen times before. But.. I think it’s for real this time. Our next goal is to get out of App Lab and onto the full Quest Store. This means we have to work on making sure Superfly meets the performance requirements necessary to do so, which is a lot of bug fixing and performance optimization we’ll be continuing to work on. This doesn't mean we're leaving the PC version of Superfly behind - all these bugfixes performance improvements will come to both the Quest and Steam versions of Superfly. We appreciate your support over these last few years, and we hope that you’ll continue to enjoy Superfly!

As always, don’t forget to check out our [url=https://discord.gg/667M4en7k2]Discord[/url] if you find any bugs, or have other questions, comments, or suggestions about Superfly!

TL;DR: New update out now, new Wanted Level System, with better health system, 11 new enemies, updated building graphics, and more difficult than ever before. See Changelog for a full list of changes.

notes.title: Superfly v1.1.4 Update
notes.content:
We're back with another update for Superfly! This update is all about sounds. The audio of Superfly admittedly hasn't been our focus for a while now, but this update should help significantly with that. First of all, we've added or updated sounds for all the powers in the game. Lots of abilities that were previously silent or that had placeholder sounds now have full sound effects, which gives a great extra level of feedback as you're playing the game. We also improved on the ambient sounds in the game, with varying ambiences for different regions of the city, as well as better ambient sounds for all the cars and blimps.

We also have a few improvements to the game that aren't related to sounds. First, we reworked the grapple hook sidegrade for the web power to have much better physics - this updated mode is my new favorite movement mode in the entire game. Try it out, and keep moving forward. We also added proper impact VFX for the kunai in the blink power, fixed some physics/jittering issues with the claw mode, and fixed a number of bugs with the giant power.

We've got a much bigger update in the works. We're planning to add a wanted system, inspired by the GTA franchise. Destroying robots will increase your wanted level, and at higher wanted levels, more dangerous enemies will appear and try to hunt you down. As part of this, we're planning to add a ton of new enemy types, many of which will have unique attacks or abilities to ramp up the challenge at high wanted levels. We're also trying a rework of the game's damage system, moving from our current hacking-effects system to a more traditional health bar. This health rework is a huge change, so we want your feedback on it before we fully add it to the game. We're planning to run an open beta test on [url=https://discord.gg/667M4en7k2]our Discord[/url], starting something this month. Please join, try out the rework, and let us know what you think!

notes.title: Superfly v1.1.3 Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone! We've got another Superfly update for you. This minor update focuses on quality of life features and performance improvements. The biggest new feature is a help section of the pause menu that explains the controls for each power. This might not be a big deal for expert players, but we hope it'll make it easier for new players to jump into the game and have fun. We've also got several quality of life improvements: new visuals for the giant and black hole modes, and new sounds for the UI and tutorial room. This update should also greatly improve performance on low-end devices, especially the Quest 1. If you're having any performance issues at all after this update, please let us know in [url=https://discord.gg/667M4en7k2]our Discord[/url] what was going on in the game when it happened. Thanks!

We're working on bigger future updates for Superfly. One major feature we're planning to add is a wanted system, inspired by the GTA franchise. Destroying robots will increase your wanted level, and at higher wanted levels, more dangerous enemies will appear and try to hunt you down. These enemies will drop additional gears, rewarding you for pushing your luck against harder challenges. On the flip side of this, if you ignore all the enemies, you'll stay at a low wanted level - perfect for peacefully flying around the city without getting harassed by robots. This wanted update will also add several new enemy types. It will likely release in a couple months.

To stay up to date with all the latest Superfly news, please join [url=https://discord.gg/667M4en7k2]our Discord[/url]. It's also the best place to report bugs, to chat with other players, or to give any suggestions or feedback to us devs. Have fun playing!

notes.title: Superfly v1.1.1 Update
notes.content:
Hi, we've got some exciting news: a new giant update for Superfly is out now! This update is giant in two ways: not only does it add the most new content of any update yet, but it adds four new powers, including a Giant mode where you can grow to be as tall as a skyscraper! The other new powers include a Blink mode where you can quickly teleport and dash around the city, a Telekinesis mode that lets you freely fly and pick up cars and enemies, and a Portals mode that lets you place any number of pairs of portals that connect spots around the city. Each new power has the usual set of customizations and sidegrades - maybe you want to shrink down instead of grow giant, or you want to fire powerful energy blasts instead of telekinetically grabbing cars - the choice is yours!

The update doesn't end there. We totally redesigned the game's UI to be prettier and more intuitive. We added 5 new race missions focused on moving along the ground instead of in midair. We added a ton of variety to the enemies' audio lines, and added optional subtitles for all of them. We made billboards and boats fully destructible. We added real physics to blimps, so you can now actually yank blimps out of the sky and smash them into the ground! The list goes on (and on, and on), see the changelog below for full details.

We have some additional changes planned for the next couple weeks. We're still working on tweaking and improving the new modes: fixing bugs, adding sound effects, and so on. We're also taking a close look at performance, the new features can cause some issues, especially on Quest. We could really use all of your help in fixing performance: if you run into any lag while playing, please let us know in [url=https://discord.gg/667M4en7k2]our Discord[/url] what was going on in the game when it happened. Thanks!

In the longer term, we're looking into ways to add more meaningful story content and progression to Superfly. I can't share many details yet because I don't know for sure what that content will look like, we're still prototyping ideas. We're also working on translating Superfly to non-English languages. If you have requests for specific languages, please let us know!

To stay up to date with all the latest Superfly news, please join [url=https://discord.gg/667M4en7k2]our Discord[/url]. It's also the best place to report bugs, to chat with other players, or to give any suggestions or feedback to us devs. Have fun playing the update, and happy holidays!

notes.title: Superfly v1.0.6 Update
notes.content:
Hi! We're back with another update for Superfly. This update was focused on closing the final gap between the PC version of Superfly and the Quest version: social features. The Steam version of Superfly has had achievements and leaderboard integration for a while now, and as of this update, the Quest version finally has them too. If you just play on the PC, this update has stuff for you too! We fixed a longstanding bug with the Lightning Super sidegrade - it should now be much easier to use now, especially while sitting down. We also added new billboard art, all designed by members of the Superfly community!

I'd also like to share our updated plans for the future of Superfly. The past couple months have been huge for us, we've seen an amazing surge of support for the game. As a result, we're actively working on adding major new content to the game. We're currently prototyping several new powers, as well as an expanded story mode with more meaningful progression. These are too early in development for us to know for sure what they'll look like, so I can't share the exact details right now, but we're hoping to start public beta tests for these features sometime in September. As always, join [url=https://discord.gg/667M4en7k2]our Discord[/url] for the latest news and announcements, and to talk with the devs and other players!

notes.title: Superfly v1.0.5 Update
notes.content:
Hey! We're back with another update for Superfly. This minor update adds a couple quality of life changes and several bug fixes that should make the game feel and work a lot better for players. This includes adding a setting to swap the Grip and Trigger buttons just for the lightning mode, as well as adding better performance and graphics on our Quest port. We were also able to resolve the smooth turning issue that several of you have been reporting – please let us know if you’re still experiencing this bug after the update. 

While we’re still working on some of the things we mentioned in our last announcement – like porting to mobile VR headsets and globalization – we’ve also been brainstorming behind the scenes. With the recent success of the Quest release, our team has been considering giving Superfly just a little more content to help flesh it out more thoroughly. This may come in the form of more content for story mode, perhaps more powers, or something else entirely. 

As usual, come check out our [url=https://discord.gg/667M4en7k2]Discord[/url] to keep up to date with announcements, or drop us a comment in our feedback channel with what you would like to see next in Superfly.

notes.title: Superfly v1.0.4 Update
notes.content:
Hi there! We're back with another update for Superfly. This minor update adds a few quality of life features that should make the game more enjoyable for new players and expert players alike. New players will appreciate the objective notifications we've added to Story Mode that guide you through all the objectives and boss fights - this doesn't add any new content, but the extra structure should make the mode feel like a much more natural progression. For expert players, we've added two secret Steam achievements. (And no, I'm not going to just say what they are - they wouldn't be much of a secret then, would they?) On top of that, we have the usual assortment of minor improvements: new graphics for rooftop objects, some bug fixes for physics and leaderboards, and so on.

Now that Superfly's in full release, we aren't planning to add any major new content to the game. We're currently working on bringing Superfly to users worldwide, adding translations into other languages. We're also continuing to work on Superfly for mobile VR, with quality of life improvements to the Quest port, as well as possibly porting to other mobile VR headsets.

After this, we aren't done making games. It's too early to share any details for sure, but our team is looking into making another VR game over the next couple years. As usual, join our [url=https://discord.gg/667M4en7k2]Discord[/url] to hear all the latest announcements!

notes.title: Superfly v0.10.2 Update
notes.content:
We're back with another update for Superfly! This is only a minor update, focused on fixing bugs and adding social features. The main new feature is a brand new leaderboard! All those gears you collect in game will now be reflected on [url=https://superflyvrgame.com/leaderboards/gears]our website[/url]. Compete with your fellow VR users and friends to see who can get the most gears!

Updates have been slow recently because we're focusing most of our effort on porting Superfly to the Oculus Quest. We're making good progress: the port should be ready sometime between May and July! The Quest version will be almost the same as the Steam version, with a couple minor differences. First, the Quest version will have improved controls and hand physics, as we're updating our input code to incorporate years of new technology in VR. Second, the Quest version will have significantly worse graphics quality - this is a necessary compromise to get decent FPS, as the Quest is much less powerful than a PC. Once we have the Quest version, we'll try to copy these improvements to controls and performance to the Steam version (though we won't lower the graphics quality of the Steam version), so everyone will end up with the best of Superfly.

Once we have an prototype for the Quest port, we plan to run a large beta test to try and find all the remaining bugs and performance issues. If you have an Oculus Quest and you're interested in joining this beta, join [url=https://discord.gg/667M4en7k2]our Discord[/url] and keep an ear out for announcements!

[/list]

notes.title: Superfly v0.10.1 Update
notes.content:
This minor update focuses on fixing a few bugs in the game. It should resolve an issue where collecting gears didn't unlock new powers in Story Mode, and another issue where all sidegrades were locked even in Free Play mode. These issues were inconsistent and only impacted a small number of users, so it's difficult to be 100% sure they're fixed - if you still experience either of these bugs, please let us know so we can keep searching for a fix.

Our current plan is to focus on fixing a few more bugs from the 0.10.0 update related to the tutorial room, then to continue adding content. We're working on adding a third boss robot, and we want to update the worm boss to match the new combat system. We also have plans to improve physical interactions with the existing blimps and boats, to tweak the city generation, and to improve the controls for some sidegrades. After all of that, we're planning to focus all of our energy on a port to the Oculus Quest! While we can't give an exact date just yet, we're hoping to publish a standalone Quest version of Superfly in the first half of this year.

As always, please join us on [url=https://discord.gg/667M4en7k2]Discord[/url] for the latest updates and announcements. Thanks for reading, and have a happy new year!

notes.title: Superfly v0.10.0 Update
notes.content:
It's been a while, but we're back with the latest major update to Superfly! This update brings Story Mode, a work-in-progress game mode that teaches the game and lets you unlock powers and sidegrades over time. The mode starts with a new and improved tutorial. After that, you need to collect gears all around the city to unlock new powers and sidegrades: 10 gears per power, and an increasing number for each sidegrade. If unlocking things over time isn't for you, don't worry, you can play the full Superfly experience immediately in Free Play mode.

This update also brings major performance improvements related to the game physics. Behind the scenes, this works by changing the physics tick rate to be slower than the frame rate, so the expensive physics calculations run less often. You can control this tick rate with the Physics Detail option in the game's settings menu. Setting the Physics Detail to High should give the same behavior as previous versions of Superfly.

Some users have reported a bug in Story Mode where collecting gears doesn't properly unlock new powers. If you experience this issue, please send us your log files on [url=https://discord.gg/667M4en7k2]our Discord server[/url] so we can fix the bug as soon as possible. You can always switch to Free Play mode to avoid the issue.

Thanks for reading, and Merry Christmas!

notes.title: Superfly v0.9.4 Update
notes.content:
The Superfly v0.9.4 update is live! Apologizes that this took so long to get out. Our main developer had to move to another country for grad school, so he hasn't had nearly as much time to work on the project. If you've been playing on the beta branch all this time, you'll already be familiar with the changes.

We added a new combat system, along with EMP attacks that disable your movement modes and hacking attacks that can defeat the player. This also adds two new enemy types, hacking orbs and EMP-spiders. Alongside this new defeat mechanic, we added a difficulty slider, going from Invincible all the way to Insane. We also fixed several bugs, you can see which ones below. Thanks again for your patience!

notes.title: Superfly v0.9.2 Update
notes.content:
This update adds new controls options for general movement, with toggles for smooth turning and for your walk direction to follow your head instead of your hand. It also modifies the Time Dilation sidegrade for the Speed mode to have more consistent controls - you now just need to hold the grip button to slow down time. There are a number of minor audio and visual improvements, including new sounds for several sidegrades and a new design for the main menu screen.

It's been a while since our last update - our lead developer was sick and unable to work on Superfly for a month or so. You can expect new content to be coming out much faster from now on! We're currently prototyping a new combat system (including a new version of player health), and we hope to have a beta version of that ready for playtesting in 3-4 weeks. Longer term, we're also working on a story mode for Superfly, which will include an updated tutorial, new boss fights, and an evil supervillain! The old in-game tutorial has been temporarily disabled in preparation, as it was causing bugs for some players.

notes.title: Superfly v0.9.1
notes.content:
This update adds a huge new feature to Superfly: power customization! You can use the in-game menu to enable [i]sidegrades[/i] for each of the movement modes, which alter the abilities and physics of the mode. Each sidegrade completely changes how the associated power plays: for example, the Thruster power has an Explosion sidegrade that lets you charge up explosions, then let them loose for a burst of speed. Each of the 8 movement modes has two unique sidegrades, and you can enable one or both at once, for over 900 different combinations across both hands!

We also added a new movement mode, the much-requested Speed mode! Just like various popular superspeed heroes, you can sprint along the ground, run up walls, and jump across building rooftops. You can attack enemies by running into them – you’re moving so fast that you can crash through enemies like a wrecking ball!

This update also brings a number of changes to the overall physics and combat systems in Superfly. The player is now much heavier and stronger than before, so you can easily lift cars into the air or smash through enemies by crashing into them. When you do smash enemies, you’ll see our new destruction effects: cars, robots, and even trees literally fall to pieces as they’re destroyed. These pieces are fully part of the physics engine, so you can pick them and throw them around too.

There are a number of other quality-of-life changes in this update as well. Billboards now spawn all around the city, including several billboards designed by Superfly community members! Cars and street objects should no longer spawn inside each other or explode right as they appear in the scene. We fixed a ton of bugs, including the Claw hitbox, cars driving in midair, startup lag, and more. See the changelog below for the full list of changes and bugfixes.

Join our [url=https://discord.gg/667M4en7k2]Discord[/url] for the latest updates about Superfly! Our Discord server is the best place to report bugs, to talk directly to the devs, or to give feedback on what you’d like to see in the future. Also check out our [url=https://superflyvrgame.com/]newly redesigned website[/url] for more info on each of the sidegrades.

We’re celebrating this update with a short sale. Check back in a couple days if you’re looking for a discount on Superfly!

notes.title: Superfly v0.8.0
notes.content:
The long-awaited update for Superfly is here, bringing a giant robot worm boss fight, a new superpower, and Steam achievements! You have to defeat the boss to unlock the new superpower – fight it at the giant red beacon of light.

The boss is a giant mechanical worm! It's made of a bunch of linked segments, and each segment has its own health bar. Despite the worm's size, it's still fully-physics based, so you can knock it around with your powers or even hold it in place. Once you beat the boss, you unlock a new superpower, the black hole mode! With this mode, you can throw black holes at the environment, then use the Trigger button to suck in everything nearby. If you suck yourself towards the black hole and release at the right time, you go flying forwards!

We're currently working on some minor tweaks to this new content: adding boss music, improving performance, and so on. If the boss fight and new superpower are popular, we’ll add more in the coming weeks, so let us know what you think!

[/list]

notes.title: Superfly v0.6.0 - Halloween Update
notes.content:
Are you ready for a super spooky time? Superfly is celebrating Halloween by with its first MAJOR UPDATE! There are plenty of treats (and tricks) in the update for you, so why don't we take a closer look:

[h3]DARK MODE[/h3]
Some mysterious floating pumpkins have been spotted in the parks of the city. Touching them will give you the option to change to Dark Mode! This mode completely redecorates the city to give it a more Halloween-y look! This also comes with a terrifying twist... you will become vulnerable to damage! Will you be able to save the city without your superhuman invulnerability? [i][b](This mode is a temporary seasonal event, but some more permanent (less spooky) version of it could exist in the future.)[/b][/i]

[h3]COMBAT MISSIONS[/h3]
What are those ominous purple lights in the distance? More content of course! A new mission type has been added to the game! Combat Missions task you with defeat waves of increasingly difficult enemies as fast as possible! These missions are currently only available in Dark Mode, and much like racing missions, you will have the option to compete on the global leaderboards for the fastest time! But be wary... the evil robots have a few tricks of their own!

There are also a bunch of more minor features that have been added to the game, including, but not limited to A NEW MECH ENEMY! He's the toughest bot yet, and fastest too, so watch out! We might have given him a bit too much candy... and is that Blimpy on the horizon?

The Halloween mode will only be around for a couple of weeks. so be sure not to miss it!
Happy Halloween from the Superfly Dev Team!

[*] New giant mech enemy!

notes.title: Superfly Roadmap
notes.content:
We've gotten a lot of feedback asking what our plans for Superfly are in the future. Here's what we're going to do!

[h1]Short term – 2 weeks[/h1]
These are the features we want to focus on in the near future. They’re all currently in-progress. While there might be some delays if things turn out harder than expected, these features are all pretty locked-in, so you can feel confident that they’ll be here soon.
[h3]Halloween update[/h3]
We’re releasing a special game update for halloween! One unique and limited-time feature: the halloween update includes a Dark Mode, where everything turns spooky, including the player’s health! No more invincibility, if you take too much damage in Dark Mode, you die!
[h3]Combat missions[/h3]
We’re adding combat missions to Superfly to go alongside the racing missions. In the combat missions, you’ll have to destroy waves of enemies as fast as you can! Just like the racing missions, your time will be recorded and uploaded to a global leaderboard so you can compete against other players.
[h3]New enemy type[/h3]
More enemies = more fun! This new enemy is a mini-boss type that’s more than twice the size of any other enemies in the game right now. It’ll be in the combat missions, so make sure you play those to face off against it! It’ll also spawn normally around the city, especially in parks.
[h3]Updated leaderboards[/h3]
The current in-game leaderboard UI could use some work, it was rushed a bit to be ready in time for the racing missions. We’re updating both the graphics and usability. This feature might be released a bit later than the others, it’s very much a work in progress.

[h1]Medium term – 2 months[/h1]
These features are longer-term. We’ve started working on some of them, but it’ll be awhile until they’re ready. Since there’s a lot more time available here, we’ll be adding more and more features to this list based on your feedback for what you want to see in the game. However, there’s also the chance that we’ll have to cut some of these features because of technical limitations that would make them too difficult to add to the game.
[h3]City graphics update[/h3]
A whole new look to the city environment! Now that Superfly has sold a few copies, we’ve been able to buy new art packs that will make the world look better than ever before. We’re also working on updates to the generation code that will make different areas of the city look more distinct from each other. In particular, we’ve already started updating parks and planning out different districts with the city.
[h3]Collectible powerups[/h3]
This idea is from player feedback! Several of you said you wanted to see collectibles in the game, and many people were interested in optional powerups that changed gameplay for a time. These powerups could make the movement modes stronger, or they could spawn giant enemies around the world! We’re still planning out the details, let us know what you think.
[h3]Even more enemy types[/h3]
Fighting the drones is a fun part of Superfly, and it’ll be even more fun with more diversity in enemy types. We’re looking into adding even more enemies, and adding more diversity to the enemies that already exist.
[h3]More movement modes[/h3]
Another idea from player feedback! A lot of people wanted to see new movement modes in the game. We’re currently designing new movement modes. Sorry, no details available yet, we’ll say more in a future update.

[h1]Long term – 6 months[/h1]
The features are very long-term future plans. Since the features below are all very technically difficult to add to games, we can’t promise that we’ll be able to add them. They might work out or they might not. If we do have to cancel any of the features below, that means that we’ll be spending more time on improving other parts of the game instead.
[h3]Multiplayer[/h3]
Facing off against your friends in the city, either working together to destroy drones, or facing off in competitive movement or combat challenges. Adding multiplayer  will require massive changes to our server infrastructure and the game’s code, so it will take a long time to implement right.
[h3]Story Mode[/h3]
Detailed storylines are a ton of fun, especially in a VR superhero game where you can grow in skill as you play through the missions. However, detailed storylines are a ton of work, requiring a ton of attention to detail and work to create even a single mission or level. If missions stay popular and people want more story content, we’ll start to dedicate more time here.
[h3]Destructible terrain[/h3]
Being able to destroy buildings or sidewalks with movement modes! This would be an amazing feature to add, but implementing it without ruining performance is extremely difficult. If this is added, it might be limited to only a small number of objects, not the entire world.
[h3]Interactive pedestrians[/h3]
What’s a city without people? It only makes sense if there are civilians walking down the streets in a city this dense. However, adding pedestrians means creating animations for every possible interaction, which is very difficult in a game as open-ended as Superfly. The pedestrian AI might also be a bit strange at first (anyone remember the old car AI?), but they’ll improve over time.
[h3]And More![/h3]
We released Superfly as Early Access so that we could get feedback from real players of the game, and so that we could use your ideas to guide our development.  Let us know what other long-term features you’d like to see!




Thanks for reading! If you want to hear more about upcoming features, or if you want to give your feedback or suggestions directly to the devs, join our Discord at [url=https://discord.gg/667M4en7k2]https://discord.gg/667M4en7k2[/url]!
-Superfly Dev Team

notes.title: Superfly v0.5.6 update
notes.content:
This minor update adds a much-requested feature, the ability to turn and walk on all controllers. This means Superfly now supports Oculus Rift setups that don't have 360-degree tracking.

With this fix out of the way, we're focusing on content updates from now on. In the short term, expect new enemy types and combat missions. More details coming soon!
